pdfRendererRetainedBackingBytes.note: Renderer mock fixture only; replacement main-process hot buffers and temporary files are accounted separately.

terminalFlow.note: Actual flow helper with an artificial slow consumer and cooperative producer. This is queue accounting, not total PTY/Electron memory or real parser throughput.

limits: No watts, battery-life, real SSH bandwidth or full-application CPU measurement.
Archive startup is measured separately; full-text search can reread evicted transcripts and is slower in this fixture.
The local catalog still scans metadata and changed files are reparsed in full. Remote response parsing and subagent header discovery remain follow-up work.
Hot PDF accounting is not total PDF process memory. Cold temporary disk usage grows with visited snapshots; abnormal termination can leave restricted files.
Dirty/live editor models and active image previews remain pinned; clean limits exclude Monaco internal/undo storage and Files text/navigation state.
Synthetic SSH and injected Monaco edits do not establish real host authentication or native keyboard/IME behavior.
Terminal backpressure can pause a live PTY while a living renderer is hung; disposal/navigation/crash release its credits.
